prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Journey", "Swipe to explore how your desktop pet will interact with your workspace."]
1: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Pet", "Creating an account backs up your pet memory, customization, and progress.", "Your pet companions stay safely synced across all logins."]
2: ["Find Your Ideal Companion", "Answer two quick questions so we can suggest the best pet personality for you.", "Preferred Vibe"]
3: ["Preparing Your Companion", "Setting up desktop pet graphics and animations. This usually takes under 2 minutes.", "Setup Tips", "Once loaded, your pet will appear directly on your desktop."]
4: ["Pet Active on Your Display!", "Your desktop pet is now live on your main monitor desktop area.", "Desktop Pet Running"]
5: ["Use bright, well-lit photos with one clearly visible subject for best accuracy.", "Recommended: JPG or PNG files under 10MB."]
6: ["Adoption Complete!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Click and drag to move your companion anywhere.", "Ready to Play", "Start Using App"]
7: ["Taking longer than usual? Verify your connection or try again below.", "Retry Connection"]
8: ["Choose Your Path First"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your pet to complete the adoption papers!", "Enter Pet Name", "Certified Companion"]
